messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: SmartRouting 'auto-fallback' policy is repeatedly failing over between us-east-1 and eu-west-1, creating a routing loop. Observed increased 5xx rate and token latency spikes for hosted/text-generation endpoints starting ~09:10 UTC. Pager to on-call (alex).

alex: acked. I'm paged, looking at routing decision logs now. First-pass: large number of fallbacks to a 'small-quant' variant that doesn't support requested seq_len and returns 502s.

maria: @alex grabbing context — are customers getting errors or just slow responses?

alex: mix. about ~40% 503/502 for affected requests, tail latency >3s for the rest. Initial spike from eu-west-1 -> fallback to small-quant in us-east-1, then that hits capacity and routes back to eu causing loop.

sam: tagging customer-impact: 12 active orgs, 3 reported errors in last 10m, 1 enterprise (acme-inc) hit with short timeouts. Notifying CS via DM.

jordan: logs look weird — decision logs missing 'route_tag' field so I can't tell whether falling back because of capacity vs incompatible variant. The decision payload only has model_id and reason: "variant_mismatch".

opbot: deploy-bot: rollback job queued for blueprint 'small-quant' in us-east-1.

alex: mitigation plan: 1) disable 'auto-fallback' policy globally (temporary) 2) pin acme-inc and other high-touch customers to stable variant (v3) 3) add explicit capacity route to eu-west-1 small instances to relieve cross-region traffic. Executing step 1 now: `rctl routing disable-policy auto-fallback --reason "incident loop"`

maria: on it — will take over pager. @alex handoff in 2 min.

alex: handoff to @maria :wave: — I pushed the disable and confirm fallbacks stopped appearing in live decisions within 30s. Traffic recovered but some queued requests on the small-quant variant still returning 502s.

maria: confirming customer impact update: error-rate peaked at 18% for affected endpoints, now down to 1.2%. acme-inc reported recovery. Sending incident note to oncall channel and CS. :white_check_mark:

sam: note — we had no route tags in decision-logs which slowed root cause. Example of problematic decision log entry we saw:```json
{"decision_id":"d-7f3a","model":"small-quant","reason":"variant_mismatch","timestamp":1700000000}
```

jordan: here's what it should include (proposal):```json
{"decision_id":"d-7f3a","model":"small-quant","route_tag":"eu->us_fallback","reason":"variant_mismatch","capacity_state":"throttled","timestamp":1700000000}
```

maria: filing immediate follow-ups: (A) add route_tag to decision logs and surface in Console (B) add a high-priority dashboard for cross-region fallback rate (C) unit test to validate policy config rejects variants without seq_len compatibility. Creating tasks now.

alex: small operational note — we temporarily pinned a few enterprise routes using: `rctl route set acme-inc --model v3 --pin true` to avoid fallback. We'll rollback pin during remediation plan.

opsbot: incidents:created  -> https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0315-19

sam: customer comms pushed: short note sent to affected orgs, CS follow-up scheduled.

jordan: root cause summary (so far): misconfigured auto-fallback policy allows region fallback without verifying variant capability; lack of route_tag and capacity_state fields in decision logs made it hard to trace whether failures were capacity or incompatibility; combined with increased load led to fallback loop.

maria: immediate mitigation complete; open follow-ups assigned to infra/serving and eng-platform: add route_tag to decision logs, validate variant compatibility earlier in policy evaluation, add circuit-breaker to prevent >N consecutive cross-region fallbacks.

alex: closing incident thread once follow-ups are tracked. Thanks all for fast response. :bow:

maria: closing notes: timeline, mitigation, customer impact, and follow-ups attached to INC-2026-0315-19. Will schedule a postmortem tomorrow 15:00 UTC.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident marked resolved by on-call (maria). Duration ~00:40. Follow-ups: ENG-PLAT-342 (add route_tag), ENG-RUNTIME-558 (variant compatibility check), DASH-120 (fallback dashboard).
